input.question: What sport is Boca Juniors associated with?

documents.text: Boca Juniors (basketball) Boca Juniors basketball section is part of the Boca Juniors sports club based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. The team plays in the Liga Nacional de Básquet (LNB), the first division of the Argentine league system. Boca's home games are played at the Estadio Luis Conde, also called the "Bombonerita" (in English: "Small Bombonera"), as a reference to the club's football stadium known as the "La Bombonera". Boca was one of the most successful teams before the creation of the LNB, winning a large amount of titles such as the Torneo Oficial, Torneo Apertura and Torneo Metropolitano organized
